Dicot leaf bundles are wrapped by bundle-sheath cells, not conjunctive tissue
Lens-shaped bark openings from ruptured epidermis are lenticels, not spongy parenchyma
Medullary-ray cells forming cambium are interfascicular cambium which is option C
→ (C)
17699:
Differential exponential growth is dN/dt = rN with r as intrinsic rate
Integration gives Nt = Noe^{rt}
Here e is Euler's number about 2.71828, the base of natural logarithms
This definition corresponds to option C
→ (C)
17700:
RNA polymerase I transcribes 28S, 18S and 5.8S rRNAs
RNA polymerase II transcribes hnRNA precursor of mRNA
RNA polymerase III transcribes tRNA, 5S rRNA and snRNA
This role corresponds to option B
→ (B)
17701:
pBR322 carries ampR and tetR marker genes
PstI site lies within the ampR coding sequence
Insertion there disrupts ampR by insertional inactivation
So recombinants lose ampicillin resistance which is option A
→ (A)
17702:
S phase performs DNA replication, matching (iv)
G2 phase synthesises proteins and RNA, matching (i)
Quiescent G0 stage is inactive and non-proliferative, matching (ii)
G1 phase is the interval before DNA replication, matching (iii) which is option C

17703:

Parasites depend on living plants, while saprophytes use dead matter
Nitrogen fixation uses heterocysts, not sheath cells
Fusion of gamete protoplasms is plasmogamy which is option B

17704:
Oxygen is used only in the terminal stage of aerobic respiration
ATP is made through complex V by the redox-driven proton gradient

Swapped yields in statement B are incorrect which is option B
→ (B)
17705:
Poaceae pollen loses viability within about 30 minutes of release
Rosaceae pollen stays viable for months after release
Leguminosae pollen also stays viable for months
This long-viability pair corresponds to option D

17706:
Nitrococcus converts ammonia to nitrite, matching (ii)
Rhizobium fixes atmospheric nitrogen to ammonia, matching (iv)
Thiobacillus drives denitrification to nitrogen gas, matching (i)
Nitrobacter converts nitrite to nitrate, matching (iii) which is option A

17707:

So the mutant clone shows no signal which is option C
→ (C)
17708:
DNA fingerprinting targets non-coding variable repeats
These variable number tandem repeats differ between individuals
Such variable stretches are termed repetitive DNA
This term corresponds to option B

17709:

Unsaturated fatty acids contain C=C double bonds, matching (i)
Nucleic acids link nucleotides by phosphodiester bonds, matching (ii)
Polysaccharides link sugars by glycosidic bonds, matching (iii) which is option A

17710:
Hollow pneumatic long bones lighten the skeleton for flight

Neophron is a vulture bird, which is option A

17711:

17714:

siRNA silences genes instead of building proteins

17729:
Sickle-cell anaemia is autosomal recessive

Their progeny are AA, Aa and aa in 1:2:1 ratio
Only aa is diseased at one in four or 25% which is option C

17730:
ELISA is based on specific antigen-antibody interaction
It detects minute amounts of antigen or antibody in blood
Hence it permits diagnosis at very low pathogen load which is option C
